notes.title: Post launch improvements round-up and a new update on the way!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I hope this message finds you well! First and foremost, I want to extend my deepest apologies for the silence on my end lately. I've been nose to the grindstone at work, striving to bring you the best experience possible. Since the release, [b]I've been tirelessly working on a series of updates to enhance Brinefall and your gaming experience[/b]. From performance tweaks to user interface refinements, every effort has been made to ensure that you get the most out of the game.

[b]I'm thrilled to let you know that a new content update is on the horizon![/b] This one's packed with exciting improvements that I'm sure you'll love. Your feedback has been invaluable, and I've taken every suggestion to heart. 

[b]As a solo developer, this journey has been a rollercoaster of challenges and triumphs[/b]. But let me assure you, my passion for this project burns brighter than ever. Your support means the world to me, and I'm committed to delivering an experience worth your support!

Thank you for your patience, and stay tuned for more updates. That's an overview of the fixes already available in-game i've released from launch on.

I want to take a minute to thank everyone once again for the feedback and feel free, to be honest. I'm doing this game for the player and not for me. Your feedback helps me a lot to improve the game! 

Have fun, everyone!

notes.title: Massive update for December
notes.notes:
[h1]New combat system, building, per weapon abilities, quests, and more![/h1]

Many of you filled out the feedback form and we listened. 

[h2]New combat system[/h2]
Faster and more instinctive combat system, including area of effect on the ground, dodge, and per weapon abilities.

[h2]Better building system[/h2]
New UI for the building system, more instinctive and faster. New ways to learn recipes as you progress in the game and tons of bugs fixed.

[h2]New game UI[/h2]
Complete overhaul of the UI of the game to fit more with Brinefall in general.

[h2]Progression[/h2]
Small quest systems to guide you through the demo from the beginning to the end of it.

[h2]And much more...[/h2]
Better performance, removed lag spikes, more fluidity in the game, and much more.

The core is done and Brinefall is slowly progressing toward its release early next year.
Thank you everyone for the feedback and feel free to provide more in the future!

notes.title: Huge combat, building overhaul and changes to come!
notes.notes:
Since the release of the demo, I have received more than a hundred feedback and it really helped to shape the future of Brinefall. Thank you!

I wanted to take a moment to keep you informed of what comes with the next massive update.

[b]Combat overhaul[/b]
The combat system will be greatly improved with weapon abilities, enemies's attacks can now be avoided and not indicate their next move.
The controls are also revamped for a better feeling.

[b]Better building system[/b]
Many bugs have been fixed, the control is improved and the recipes will be learnable.

[b]And much more![/b]
Improved quest system, invasions, bosses, better audio, and elites to fight.

The example above is just to name a few but I wanted to take the time to inform you about the development and tell you that the feedback was really useful to pinpoint what needed to be done. I will still need some time before I can release the update but I can't wait to share it and get your feedback!
